caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden mantel clock with a reddish-brown wood grain exterior and decorative scalloped top and bottom edges. The clock face is white with black Roman numerals and black minute and hour hands, as well as a thin black second hand, all encased in a rectangular frame. Below the clock face is a painted panel bordered by yellow leaves, depicting a landscape scene with green trees, a grassy area, a body of water, and a group of white buildings with red rooftops. The clock is vertically oriented, and there are two slender columns on either side, painted to simulate wood grain similar to the main body. The background is a plain beige or cream-colored surface with visible marks, stains, and slight discolorations.
title: Shelf Clock
